description: Cohort plan for moving cron and user units off the dev tree's code and .venv onto the served release (WS7-01 / WS8-14). Read by scripts/run_from_release.py. A crontab job is assigned to the FIRST cohort whose `match` regex (Python re.search) hits its command text and whose `exclude` regexes do not. Jobs no cohort selects stay on the header $PY until the `final` step. Nothing here installs anything: the generator writes candidate files and diffs only.
exclude_units_note: portfolio-server's drop-in is written by write_systemd() in scripts/cio_phase2_exact_main_deploy.sh; the release venv lands there by changing VENV_PYTHON, not by a drop-in.
broker_adjacent_note: AGENTS.md section 0 rule 2. A job whose command contains one of these markers, or a path matching the broker.execution_code_edit globs in config/agents_guard_hook_rules.json, is never placed in an early cohort: the generator refuses to select it for any cohort except one with `broker_adjacent_allowed: true`. Conservative on purpose; a false positive only delays a job.

cohorts.title: Read-only reports and no-notify hygiene lanes (direct $PY, no wrapper) — 6 lines
cohorts.rationale: Chosen from the 2026-10-15 verifier run: each line calls one python script directly with $PY (no shell wrapper), the script passes the sandboxed --help from CURRENT under the release venv, and it sends nothing (no Telegram, no paid LLM, no broker). Writes: logs/ and persistent-state receipts (linked), symbol_profiles rows, CIO draft-plan expiry receipts. A wrong interpreter shows up as an ImportError in the next run's log; a missed run costs one stale report. Excluded on purpose: watch_directive_hygiene (sends Telegram P1), market_regime_* and compute_source_weights (--apply writers that feed decisions) go to c2.

cohorts.title: Remaining direct-$PY python lanes (data ingest, analytics, CIO batch)
cohorts.rationale: Same mechanism as c1 at volume; includes DB writers and paid-LLM lanes that run under the off-peak wrapper. Promote only after c1 has a clean natural day plus forced runs.

cohorts.title: Shell-wrapper lanes whose wrappers resolve $PROJ/$PY from the environment
cohorts.rationale: The exported PY/TRADEAI_VENV_PYTHON reach the wrapper; only wrappers the verifier marks clean or env-overridable belong here. Wrappers that hard-code the dev tree (`PROJ="<dev>"`) are refused by the verifier and wait for c4.

cohorts.title: Broker-adjacent and money-path lanes (stops, options monitors, protection, scalps)
cohorts.rationale: Operator-supervised, market closed, one at a time, after the wrapper code fixes have shipped in a release.

unit_cohorts.u1: Timer-driven oneshot services that are not broker-adjacent
unit_cohorts.u2: Long-running daemons (Restart=, Type=simple) that are not broker-adjacent; each joins TRADEAI_CURRENT_BOUND_UNITS so promote restarts it
unit_cohorts.u3: Broker-adjacent units and units running from a feature worktree: operator decision per unit
